ArcFace target logit = s cos(θᵧ + m)

Ten reference games provide a noisy estimate of each player’s style
v꜀ = 0.8 × pooled variance + 0.2 × player variance + floor
Gaussian score combines a variance-scaled distance
with a log-variance penalty; uncertainty scales with 1/k + 1/10.
The best fusion uses z(coordinate score) + 0.25 z(MLP cosine) + 0.10 z(Gaussian).
